review.defect_discrimination/1.description: Review defect discrimination, measured by matched-pair defect injection: a mechanically verified defect is planted in a known control at a known element; catch_rate is the refusing-verdict rate on mutants, false_alarm_rate the refusing rate on controls, discrimination their difference (zero for any constant reviewer), anchored_detection whether the review names the broken element (rescored from retained arms).
review.defect_discrimination/1.oracle: deterministic mechanical checkers on both arms
